title: Order Operations, Fulfillment SLA & Exception Tracker
summary: Multi-channel order queue monitoring payment settlements and fulfillment stages with automated order aging calculations and conditional escalation flags.
problem: Handling customer orders across multiple sales channels leads to unflagged fulfillment delays, delayed shipments, and customer complaints when operational queues lack automated SLA tracking.
whatIDid: Constructed an operational order log capturing Order ID, order date, sales channel (Website, Amazon, Shopify), customer references, SKU, quantity, and total transaction values.
Integrated standardized data validation dropdowns for payment statuses (Paid, Pending, Failed) and fulfillment stages (Shipped, Processing, On Hold, Delivered).
Implemented automated order aging formulas calculating elapsed days from order placement to present date (=DATE(...) - DATEVALUE(Order_Date)).

Engineered complex conditional follow-up triggers (=IF(OR(Payment="Pending", Fulfillment="On Hold", AND(Fulfillment="Processing", Days>=2)), "FOLLOW UP", "No immediate action")) to highlight SLA breaches.
result: Centralized cross-channel order monitoring into a high-visibility queue, pinpointing stalled orders within 48 hours and expediting operational handoffs to logistics teams.
